verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents registered agent or service-of-process handling offered by Earth Class Mail/Virtual Mail, whether bundled with or added to a mailbox plan. The nearest items are adjacent, not this capability: integration with LegalZoom business formation services (Secretary of State status reports, 'other entitled services') and listing a virtual address on public records. A virtual mail provider could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get registered agent service tied to the same account — service-of-process handling bundled with or added to my mailbox plan
